name: banded-face-pull
instructions:
1. Assume a split stance with the arms straight out in front of you utilizing a pronated grip.
2. Inhale, brace your abs, and pull the band towards your face with the elbows high and wide.
3. Slowly lower the band back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
